rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “huge” means physically very large.

example.english: That house is really huge; you can fit however many tables inside.
example.traditional: 嗰間屋真係好大，入面擺幾多張枱都得。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 uk1 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 jap6 min6 baai2 gei2 do1 zoeng1 toi2 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this for a person, band, song, or album that is very popular or successful.

example.english: That band has been huge lately; every concert is sold out.
example.traditional: 嗰隊樂隊最近真係好紅，場場演唱會都爆滿。
example.jyutping: go2 deoi6 ngok6 deoi6 zeoi3 gan6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hung4 coeng4 coeng4 jin2 coeng3 wui2 dou1 baau3 mun5

rows.note: Use this when “huge” means very powerful, formidable, or strong.

example.english: Your new computer is huge; it edits videos without any lag.
example.traditional: 你部新電腦真係好勁，剪片完全唔窒。
example.jyutping: nei5 bou6 san1 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6 zin2 pin3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zat6

rows.note: Use this when “huge” means strongly dedicated to a cause or activity.

example.english: They’re huge supporters of volunteer work and help out every Sunday.
example.traditional: 佢哋對做義工好熱心，個個星期日都去幫手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 zou6 ji6 gung1 hou2 jit6 sam1 go3 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 bong1 sau2
